From your first experience.
To your next opportunity.
The end of your studies can be the start of something bigger. Meet Alumni: connecting the experience you’ve gained with opportunities to work abroad.
More about Alumni
What brings us together
Experience behind you.
Opportunity ahead.
An internship builds practical experience. Graduation opens a new chapter. Alumni connects people at this turning point with employers and recruitment agencies in international job markets.
Connection
Bring your experience and ambitions into a conversation with the people looking for their next colleague.
Growth
Build on your qualification and internship experience as you take your next step into working life.
Guidance
A good next step starts with understanding what you bring, what you’re looking for and where you want to go.
Opportunity
Look beyond familiar borders. A new role can be a chance to discover a different place, team and perspective.
Who we help
A new career. A new colleague.
A good connection.
For graduates ready to explore working abroad, and the employers and recruitment agencies looking to meet them.
For graduates & former interns
Your career abroad
Finished your studies and ready for working life? Alumni connects graduates with internship experience to job opportunities in foreign labour markets.
Tell us about your background, interests and where you’d like to work. Start a conversation about your next step.
Explore my next step
For employers
Your next colleague
Looking for people at the beginning of their careers? Connect with graduates who bring a qualification, internship experience and ambition to their next role.
Tell us about your team, the roles you’re recruiting for and the experience you’re looking for.
Discuss a hiring need
For recruitment agencies
Your next talent connection
Recruiting for international vacancies? Alumni brings recruitment agencies together with graduates entering the labour market.
Let’s discuss the roles and markets you work with, and explore where there could be a fit.
Explore a collaboration

Our roots
An independent vision.
Built on experience.
Alumni is an independent company, brought together by the people behind JongLeren and K.B. JongLeren’s connection to international internships provides a natural starting point. Alumni focuses on the chapter that follows: graduates entering the labour market and exploring work abroad.
JongLeren
A human perspective
K.B.
A forward-thinking mindset
Independent by design. Connected through people.
